note: index = the clip number in the GLB (Crucible). Unity finds clips by name.

clips.name: Cannon_ChargeLoop
clips.notes: Loop while charging. The orb turns 2.5 times a second; the barrel shivers.

props.notes: Loop while charging. The orb turns 2.5 times a second; the barrel shivers.

clips.name: Cannon_ChargeStart
clips.notes: Barrel draws back and dips as it loads; the orb spins up to full speed (one turn). Ends in ChargeLoop's first pose.

props.notes: Barrel draws back and dips as it loads; the orb spins up to full speed (one turn). Ends in ChargeLoop's first pose.

clips.name: Cannon_Fire
clips.notes: Fire on frame 1: the barrel slides back 0.38 m and rocks 10 degrees back, then settles. The orb slows from full speed to a stop (two turns).

props.notes: Fire on frame 1: the barrel slides back 0.38 m and rocks 10 degrees back, then settles. The orb slows from full speed to a stop (two turns).

PowerUp.notes: Start all three on the same frame. While moving, play only the torso and head clips; the legs keep their locomotion.

CannonShot_L.notes: Play after Cannon_ChargeStart (0.8 s) and Cannon_ChargeLoop (looped while held). Start both clips on the same frame.

CannonShot_R.notes: Play after Cannon_ChargeStart (0.8 s) and Cannon_ChargeLoop (looped while held). Start both clips on the same frame.
